## Core Specialties (SEO, AIO & Full-Stack Marketing)
- **Search Engine Optimization (SEO)**: Technical SEO audits, Core Web Vitals optimization, semantic site architecture, Schema.org JSON-LD entity graphs, local SEO (Sri Lanka & UAE), and authority content frameworks.
- **AI Engine Optimization (AIO / GEO / LLMO)**: Optimizing brand entities, structured FAQ/HowTo/Service schema, factual clarity, and machine-readable `llms.txt` documentation so brands are surfaced and cited accurately by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.
- **Full-Stack Growth Marketing**: Connected acquisition systems across Google Search/Performance Max, Meta Ads (Instagram & Facebook), LinkedIn B2B campaigns, landing page CRO, and automated WhatsApp/CRM lead routing.
